original_test_intent: Verify BMC-to-UBB SMC PLDM/MCTP support for mapped GPU numeric sensors and health state, including separately scoped SMC-reset and GPU-power-cap effectors when those optional branches are enabled.
original_method: Discover the exact PLDM endpoint and PDR mapping; capture timestamped idle numeric/health values; run approved stress within limits and compare mapped values; for each explicitly enabled optional branch, record baseline, issue the documented effector once, observe the defined result and restore/verify the prior state.
manual_activity: The owner supplies endpoint/PDR/sensor mapping, stress limits and optional-branch scope; an operator monitors stress and any approved reset or power-cap mutation and confirms recovery.
required_inputs: BMC/UBB/SMC/GPU identities, MCTP EIDs/termini and firmware revisions
PLDM type-2 PDR IDs, sensor IDs, units/resolution/status and health-state mapping
Compatible pldmtool/stack plus complete structured command schema
Approved stress workload, duration, thermal/power stop limits and expected directional behavior
For reset: exact effector ID/state, disconnection/recovery windows and independent console
For capping: exact effector/value encoding, legal range, AGT mapping, original limit and restoration
safety_requirements: Keep discovery and baseline reads strictly read-only and preserve logs
Require separate explicit approval before stress, SMC reset or GPU power-cap write
Do not infer sensor identity from display names; bind readings to endpoint/PDR/sensor IDs and units
Use bounded observation windows; stop on thermal/power excursion, endpoint loss, host/GPU fault or restore failure
Protect credentials and preserve all PLDM requests/responses; no automatic write retry
agent_execution_scope: Discover and validate endpoint/PDR/sensor/effector identities and collect idle readings
Run only the approved bounded stress and collect synchronized PLDM telemetry/health
If reset branch is approved, send one exact effector request and observe disconnect plus recovery
If cap branch is approved, capture AGT baseline, write one legal cap, verify it and restore the baseline
Package raw and normalized evidence while leaving PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED to the engineer
engineer_actions: Approve topology, PDR mapping, units/state expectations, stress and optional-branch scope
Approve exact reset/cap encodings, impact, recovery and final-state policy
Review sensor trends, health correlation and any effector/restoration evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: pldmtool discovery/GetPDR is a valid prerequisite but not the test: it neither reads the named type-2 sensors under two workloads nor verifies health/reset/cap behavior. sshpass and disabled host-key checking are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-compatible structured PLDM interface to bind PDRs to exact endpoints and sensors, collect synchronized idle/stress values, and execute only separately approved single reset/cap effectors with before/after/recovery/restore evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU_x_DIE_TEMP, GPU_x_MEMORY_TEMP, GPU_x_POWER, xxx_HEALTH, idle versus stress, optional reset/cap, example 500 W and 5/30-minute estimates remain, with 500 W treated only as a source example pending legal-range approval.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL PHASED PLDM TELEMETRY AND OPTIONAL EFFECTOR TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an endpoint/PDR manifest first, then run synchronized sensor sampling with workload markers; model each optional effector as its own approved transaction with immutable request/response, bounded recovery and final-state verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact sensor identity/units, complete coverage beyond GetPDR, protected access, conditional branch accounting and reversible effectors without erasing source logs.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Discovery proves that records exist, not that temperature/power respond to workload, health is correct or effectors work; each criterion needs distinct evidence and optional branches must be reported as in-scope or not-run.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Higher readings are directional rather than quantitative and may be workload/telemetry dependent. Reset and capping can disrupt control or thermal policy, so values and recovery cannot be guessed.

project_override_considerations: A project may mark one or both effectors out of scope; the record must explicitly report the branch disposition and cannot claim that GetPDR or sensor reads cover a branch omitted by approval.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and BMC/UBB/SMC/GPU/MCTP/firmware/tool identities
Complete PDR-to-sensor/effector map with units, state definitions and raw discovery
Timestamped idle/stress workload and die/memory temperature, power and health readings
Stress limits/health logs and directional comparison for every mapped GPU sensor
If enabled, exact reset request/status/disconnect/recovery evidence
If enabled, AGT baseline, cap request/status/observed value and restored limit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source defines coherent mandatory telemetry/health phases and explicitly optional effector phases. Missing mappings, safe values and scope are project execution inputs, while DeepSeek's incomplete GetPDR suggestion is not authoritative source coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool stack, PDR mapping and approvals gate execution but do not prevent a complete static review; optional branches can remain explicitly not run until authorized.

review_improvement: Expands the evidence contract from protocol discovery to every named sensor and conditional effector while making each disruptive action separately auditable and reversible.
independent_technical_reasoning: Numeric sensor comparison is credible only when idle and stress samples refer to the same endpoint, sensor ID, units and status with synchronized workload timestamps; names alone can alias different devices. A health state needs an authoritative enum-to-platform mapping, not a generic nonzero check. Reset disconnection is a transient effect and must be paired with bounded recovery, while a power-cap write is incomplete until the observed AGT value and restored original limit are both proven. The optional labels change execution scope, not the need to record whether each branch ran.
